links.label: Himalayas Remote Jobs API
links.description: Free public JSON API for remote job data — no authentication required. Two endpoints: GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api browses the full jobs feed with cursor pagination (pass each response's nextCursor back as ?cursor=; offset still works but is deprecated); GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api/search returns filtered results by keyword (q), country, worldwide availability, seniority, employment type, company slug, timezone, and sort order. OpenAPI 3.1 spec at https://himalayas.app/docs/openapi.json. AI plugin manifest at https://himalayas.app/.well-known/ai-plugin.json.

bare_links.label: > Himalayas (https://himalayas.app) is the leading remote job board, connecting job seekers with verified remote opportunities at top companies worldwide. Founded in 2020, Himalayas serves both sides of remote hiring: job seekers use free AI-powered tools to find and apply for remote jobs, while employers post jobs and search 200,000+ candidate profiles to hire distributed teams. For AI agents, the Himalayas MCP Server provides 41 tools covering the full remote hiring lifecycle — from job search to job posting to candidate outreach.

- [Himalayas Remote Jobs API](https://himalayas.app/api): Free public JSON API for remote job data — no authentication required. Two endpoints: `GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api` browses the full jobs feed with cursor pagination (pass each response's `nextCursor` back as `?cursor=`; `offset` still works but is deprecated); `GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api/search` returns filtered results by keyword (q), country, worldwide availability, seniority, employment type, company slug, timezone, and sort order. OpenAPI 3.1 spec at https://himalayas.app/docs/openapi.json. AI plugin manifest at https://himalayas.app/.well-known/ai-plugin.json.
